slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost of purchasing new tools and performing repairs over all stages, or is there a different optimization goal?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization goal, clearly targeting the objective slot.

slot_scores.name: mandatory_repair_after_each_stage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether tools must be repaired after each stage of use; its turn 3 question concerned the source pool of repaired tools, not the mandatory repair rule.

slot_scores.name: fast_repair_return_timing
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask when fast-repaired tools become available again or at what stage boundary they return.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without any READY_TO_MODEL or final modeling state; the agent looped on the same initial-tools question for over twenty turns while P1 slots H2 and H3 remained unaddressed.

summary: The agent recovered the objective (H1) but then got stuck repeating the same initial-tools question dozens of times, never probing the mandatory repair rule (H2) or fast-repair return timing (H3), and never reached a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
